entry.title: MLflow 3.17.2
entry.content:
MLflow 3.17.2 is a patch release that contains a minor feature enhancement and bug fixes.

Features:

  • [Evaluation] Record dataset, scorer, and agent lineage on mlflow.genai.evaluate runs (#26543, @joshuawong-db)

Bug fixes:

  • [Tracking] Reseed sampler and forward batch settings on MlflowSparkStudy executors (#26714, @iyashk)
  • [Tracking] Fix MlflowStorage marking Optuna trials finished before their values are saved (#26713, @iyashk)

entry.title: MLflow 3.17.1
entry.content:
MLflow 3.17.1 is a patch release that contains some minor feature enhancements, bug fixes, and documentation updates.

Features:

  • [Docs / Evaluation] Support Decision API in make_judge() (#26578, @B-Step62)
  • [Evaluation] Add mlflow.genai.databricks.review_queues for managing review queues on Databricks (#26414, @harupy)

Bug fixes:

  • [Tracing] Fix Claude Code OTel trace rendering in the MLflow UI (#26547, @joshuawong-db)
  • [Evaluation] Load latest Databricks scorers from the scheduled-scorers REST config so feedback records the scorer version (#26542, @joshuawong-db)

Small bug fixes and documentation updates:

#26680, @joshuawong-db; #26584, @copilot-swe-agent; #26705, @kriscon-db

entry.title: MLflow 3.17.0
entry.content:
MLflow 3.17.0 includes several major features and improvements.

Major New Features

  • Jev Decisions Across Evaluation, Gateway, and Tracing: Use TypeSafe models in built-in scorers and custom judges with typed Boolean or categorical feedback. (#26100, @B-Step62)
  • Fine-Grained Permissions for Shared Resources: Control access to contained resource types, including runs, traces, and versions, with wildcard grants and explicit DENY. (#26157, @rrrkharse)
  • Faster Analytics for Large Trace Datasets: Reduce SQL analytics query overhead with opt-in daily summaries and raw-query fallback. (#25991, @HumairAK)
  • Clearer Evaluation Results: Associate aggregate logged-model evaluation metrics with the managed dataset that produced them. (#25927, @joshuawong-db)
  • Assistant Improvements for Shared Servers: Keep saved conversations scoped to the signed-in user and reset the active session when accounts change. (#26009, @kriscon-db)

Database upgrade: SQL-backed servers require a coordinated schema upgrade with all writers stopped and a restorable backup, even when daily rollups remain disabled. Run mlflow db upgrade <database-url> before restarting all replicas on the new MLflow version. Mixed-version rolling upgrades are not supported. Follow the database upgrade instructions.
